primary.hypothesis: The dual-LoRA endpoint will exceed the strict-frozen endpoint on compositional caption discrimination.

secondary.hypothesis: The dual-LoRA endpoint will not lose more than 2 percentage points relative to the strict-frozen endpoint.

stopping_rule: Each frozen checkpoint is evaluated once. No prompt, checkpoint, task, threshold, category, or metric is changed in response to results.
multiplicity: Only SugarCrepe overall accuracy is primary. All other values are secondary or diagnostic and are labelled accordingly.
